actions.action: Check top 3-5 cm of soil for dryness before watering
Ensure pot drains and empty standing water from saucer
If yellowing worsens or soil smells sour, unpot and inspect roots for rot
Remove badly yellowed leaves with clean scissors
Move plant closer to a window for bright indirect light
